runtime_pipeline.baseline: Official Ricoh GR IV v1.20 baseline (China Mainland)
runtime_pipeline.dsp_service_lifecycle: Ricoh commercial firmware never invokes DspFactory::CreateDspService (0x5398d8fc) at boot, leaving singleton member [0x553a3164] permanently NULL. Cave 2 detects m_dspService == NULL on Frame 1 and dynamically invokes CreateDspService(this, 0) (0x5398d8fc), instantiating DspService, creating RTOS primitives (DspMtx, DspSF, DspReq, DspExc), and mounting queues before proceeding to DSP loading.
runtime_pipeline.stock_rom_bugfix: Patched v1.20 DspService::LoadDsp (0x5398ef68 & 0x5398efac) to pass `sub r1, fp, #0x40` (DF_ID_S.BIN & DF_IP.BIN) with dual-drive polling ('C': SD card, 'I': Internal 53GB flash) and relaxed drive letter check (0x5398eedc) up to drive 15
runtime_pipeline.mmu_and_dsp_base: CEVA-XM4 VLIW instructions require native 0x52100000 base. Swapped Pool[3] (DspFw) to 0x52100000 (4 MB) and Pool[8] (ImageAdjustWork) to 0x51200000 (15 MB), patched ChunkLoader (0x5398e178) & LoadDsp (0x5398ee9c) base checks to 0x5210, and patched boot vector parameter r1=0x52100000 into DspService::Start
runtime_pipeline.af_architecture: Pure K-3 III Deep Learning Exclusive (Stock FotoNation 100% Disabled): Cave 2 directly invokes CEVA-XM4 DSP pipeline. Eliminates all ambiguity between stock FotoNation tracking and CEVA-CV neural inference.
runtime_pipeline.dual_box_diagnostics: Dual visual telemetry: (1) Top-Left Box (x=40, y=40, 32x32, score=88): Triggers if DspService is instantiated but LoadDsp fails on SD card. (2) Lower-Right Heartbeat Box (x=240, y=140, 32x32, score=99): Triggers when DSP boots, AHIP frames dequeue, and IPC WaitMessage succeeds, but no subject is detected in current frame. (3) Dynamic Green Box: Subject detected by neural network and tracked by PDAF.
runtime_pipeline.hook1_boot_awakening: LiveViewProcess3aContoller (0x53676ab8) -> Cave 1 (0x53000d60) zeroes STATUS_VA (0x52c00100..0x52c0011f) on singleton creation without blocking early-boot 3A init on SD I/O
runtime_pipeline.hook2_continuous_ai_af: FaceDetectionService::Task (0x5389639c) -> Cave 2 (0x53000e00) uses constructor-zeroed [r4, #0x13e] to initialize boot retry counter, polls SD card ('C') and internal memory ('I'), uses correct return check (bne cave2_load_ok for 1==SUCCESS), calls StartDsp(r1=0x52100000), then executes pure K-3 III CEVA-XM4 CNN inference
runtime_pipeline.safe_ddr_zones: All shared buffers relocated to verified unmanaged, fully-mapped DDR (0x52930000..0x53000000): Weights @ 0x52960000..0x52a76220, Tensor In @ 0x52b00000, Tensor Out @ 0x52b02a00, Msg @ 0x52c00000, Status @ 0x52c00100 - zero collision with weights or RTOS Live View Pool[8]
runtime_pipeline.cold_start_lock: Seeds [r4, #0x100..0x10c] = (rect_cx, rect_cy, box_size, box_size), [r4, #0x118]/[r4, #0x11c] = face_id, [r4, #0x13c] = 1, [r4, #0x121] = 0, [r4, #0x124] = 0 so SelectMainFace and EVENT 0x04070001 lock instantaneously on Frame 1 from any head pose
runtime_pipeline.frame_source: Completed Ahip ring descriptor *(*(0x550813d0 + 0x434)) (fallback 0x424 / 0x1c / 0x14) dequeued by AhipService::WaitFrame + ARM D-Cache invalidate (0x5391801c) prior to CPU read
runtime_pipeline.downsampler: Aspect-ratio-aware ([r4, #0xfc] x [r4, #0xfe]) YUV420 -> 3-plane 56x56 (row stride 64) RGB tensor @ 0x52b00000 with C0-continuous 2.0x backlit shadow recovery (Y < 48 -> 2x, 48..144 -> 72 + Y/2) + ARM D-Cache clean/barrier (0x5391808c)
runtime_pipeline.dsp_inference: msg_id 4 via SendMessage (0x5398e478) & WaitMessage (0x5398e794, timeout 5000 ms) with full K-3 III weights @ 0x52960000 (677,824 B) & 0x52a057c0 (461,408 B)
runtime_pipeline.output_heatmap: Head-priority (fg = max(Ch1, Ch2 - 2)) 3-channel 56x56 (row stride 64) int16_t segmentation map @ 0x52b02a00 + D-Cache invalidate (0x5391801c)
runtime_pipeline.face_result_structure: 100-byte zeroed m_DetectedFaceResult [r4, #0x78] in aspect-ratio-scaled Q8 fixed-point with dynamic blob-area box sizing [0x2800..0x5c00]
runtime_pipeline.af_tracking_target: Native dispatch via UpdateFaceDetectionResult (0x538959f4); directly populates m_DetectedFaceResult and updates FdLibraryService state
runtime_pipeline.lcd_osd_rendering: UpdateFaceDetectionResult (0x538959f4) renders green AI Face/Eye box on LCD and fires EVENT 0x04070001 to AF
runtime_pipeline.af_system: GR4 165-point on-sensor PDAF (Zaf) locks onto detected subject centroid
